description: Speeches in the Swiss Parliament (both chambers) in the current legislature from the Official Bulletin index (Parliamentary Services): who spoke, in which council, when (to the second), for how long, on which item, with the link to the Official Bulletin where the text is. Filter by speaker (name), business number, session id or date (YYYY-MM-DD). The words themselves are not stored here; follow the bulletin link. Returns at most 50, newest first.
name: search_speeches
